hypothesis: Restricting the V15 one-escape attack gate to one or two learned bombs per round will retain at least 0.025 additional kills per multiplayer game while eliminating V15's self-kill and loop-rate regressions and preserving score, survival, action correctness, and earlier-task collection.
changed_factor: Both arms use the fixed V12 t85 head only for BOMB proposals, require a threatened opponent to have at most one immediate move outside the blast, disable pursuit movement overrides, and retain the seven-step safe-continuation follow-up. The sole comparison is one versus two learned bomb overrides per round.
controls: Same frozen checkpoint, learned t85 artifact, one-escape geometry, empty-board context, broad persistent loop guard, action mask, scenarios, opponents, slots, evaluator, metrics, gates, and paired fresh seeds. No parameters, rewards, features, or DQN weights are changed.
selection: Among pilot-eligible fixed caps, choose the largest kill gain, then score gain, then the lower learned-bomb cap. Confirm once on fresh worlds; never promote automatically.

expected_cost.basis: Observed V15 throughput on this PC.

pc.note: Cumulative issue #225 debit through completed V15; the shared 40 CPU-hour cap is not reset.
